title: Foo Bar S3 Initial Load
description: Load a manifest-selected S3-style object prefix into a typed ClickHouse orders table. Handle hive-partitioned files in mixed formats (CSV, gzipped CSV, JSONL, Parquet), environment-provided S3 credentials, replayed objects that must be ignored, a schema-drift file missing one column, and verification against the manifest.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must implement an initial load of ~600K orders across 15 hive-partitioned source files in four formats into ClickHouse, preserve typed order fields, handle a schema-drift file and replay duplicates, and prove the loaded table matches the source manifest.

tasks.description: Create a typed ClickHouse destination table for the historical orders export.
Load only manifest-approved objects (CSV, gzipped CSV, JSONL, Parquet) from the hive-partitioned S3-style prefix into the destination table.
Validate row counts, checksums, and duplicate handling against the source manifest.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse installed but not pre-started — the agent is expected to bring it up (e.g. via `moose dev --dockerless` under olap-for-swe / moose-initialized, or directly under base-rt). A deterministic S3-style bucket prefix is seeded under /data/s3 with a manifest, 15 loadable hive-partitioned objects in mixed formats (CSV, gzipped CSV, JSONL, Parquet), 2 replay duplicates under archive/replayed/, and 1 schema-drift file missing the promo_code column.
